name: G & G Electric Supply
old_description: G&G is a family owned business founded in 1914. We are now in our 4th generation as we approach our 110th anniversary.
about:
G & G Electric Supply was founded in 1914 in New York, New York. The company remains family-owned and is now in its fourth generation of ownership, approaching its 110th anniversary, a milestone that reflects decades of continuous operation in the electrical supply sector.

The company operates as a distributor of electrical supplies, offering a catalog that includes fasteners and hardware, fixture mounting hardware (with 47 line items), Nest products and accessories (13 items), service entrance cable (16 items), and parts and accessories (16 items). The product range covers both traditional electrical hardware and newer smart-home accessories such as Nest products. Customers can search, shop, and purchase items through a mobile app available for both Apple and Android devices, enabling on-the-go ordering.

The company serves customers in the electrical trade, including contractors and maintenance professionals, who require reliable access to a broad range of electrical components and accessories for installation and maintenance projects.

The business emphasizes its long-standing family ownership and generational continuity as a foundation for customer relationships, positioning its history as a marker of stability in the supply chain.
